name: cms-pages
title: CMS Pages
description: Shared catch-all route that renders dynamic pages from Payload CMS and/or Builder.io with automatic fallback.
docs: Shared CMS catch-all route at `src/app/(app)/[...slug]/page.tsx`. Checks Payload CMS first, then falls back to Builder.io, so both CMS systems coexist on the same URL space. Installs the `payload` and `builder-io` items as registry dependencies; `features-config` detects which CMS is enabled from env vars. Payload CMS needs `DATABASE_URL` and `PAYLOAD_SECRET`; Builder.io needs `NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILDER_API_KEY`.
